visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches out to turn a silver door handle, opening a light wood door to reveal a dimly lit bedroom. A woman is seen sleeping under a thick beige quilt on a large bed with floral-patterned pillows. (2) The woman, with long dark hair and wearing a white spaghetti-strap camisole, wakes up and stretches her arms before playfully pulling a green-lined duvet over her head. The room is now brightly lit with soft indoor light. (3) A pair of hands in a kitchen area empties a white plastic bag containing "Q Burger" breakfast items. Two cups and two wrapped sandwiches are carefully arranged on a wooden tray atop a grey countertop. (4) Back in the bedroom, the woman is sitting up against the headboard, looking at a smartphone. A small, light-brown cocker spaniel dog rests on the pillows behind her. A wooden nightstand holds a small jar. (5) In a modern bathroom with grey tiled walls, the woman brushes her teeth vigorously while looking in the mirror. She wears dark athletic shorts with white stripes. She then splashes water on her face and pats it dry. (6) The woman sits on a large, light grey sectional sofa in a bright living room. She unwraps a paper-wrapped sandwich and eats it while the beige dog sits on the floor nearby. A wooden coffee table holds breakfast cups. (7) A hand reaches into the frame to straighten various light-colored throw pillows on the grey sofa. A high-angle shot shows a Dyson vacuum cleaner being pushed across a white plush rug and then onto a light-tiled floor. (8) Various colorful plush toys are scattered on the floor. A hand picks up a grey stuffed animal, a red toy, and a brown donut-shaped plush, placing them into a round woven storage basket. (9) The woman lies comfortably on the grey sofa, covered by a striped blanket, while watching an anime series on a television screen. A plate of green grapes and snacks are placed on the black coffee table. (10) The woman demonstrates the features of the "眠豆沙" sofa, showing the adjustable headrest and the depth of the seat. She lies down fully on the sofa and ottoman to showcase the comfort and support of the furniture.

A female voice is heard groaning softly and speaking in a sleepy, breathy tone with high pitch. (2) Loud, percussive rustling of plastic bags fills the track as breakfast is prepared. The sound of solid items being tapped against a wooden tray creates short, dry acoustic transients. The BGM remains consistently in the background. (3) A male voice speaks at a moderate conversational volume and neutral tone. The woman responds with playful, high-pitched whining. The rustling of bedsheets provides a soft, broadband noise background to the dialogue. (4) Constant, rushing water noise from a faucet is prominent. This is accompanied by the rhythmic, scratchy friction of toothbrushing and the echoing splashes of water hitting a sink basin. The BGM continues with a steady beat. (5) The female voice speaks clearly while eating, with subtle chewing sounds and the sharp "clack" of a cup being set on a hard surface. The BGM's synth elements become more noticeable. (6) Low-frequency thuds occur as pillows are fluffed and hit. This transitions into a high-pitched, steady motorized drone from a vacuum cleaner. The drone has a wide spectral bandwidth and consistent intensity throughout the cleaning sequence. (7) Clattering sounds of plastic toys hitting each other are heard as they are tidied. The male and female engage in a casual, upbeat conversation with high arousal and positive valence. (8) Background audio from a TV is audible, featuring Japanese speech and exaggerated cartoon sound effects. The main female speaker describes a product with an informative, friendly, and slightly animated vocal tone and clear articulation. (9) The BGM swells slightly, featuring more melodic synthesizer textures and a clear, steady rhythm. The woman's speech is continuous, with few pauses, as she highlights the sofa's benefits, ending on a warm and satisfied vocal note.
